text_block_list.text:
It's evening, and I'm in my room crafting a
plan to help Nature beat
Токай Тейо at the
Tracen Meet.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Uma Attack! Good evening, it's your
beloved trainee!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Sorry for coming by so late, Trainer. I
forgot some stuff in the trainer
office,
sooo... mind lending me the keys?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, it'd be a hassle to return them
tonight, so I'll unlock the
room for you
tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: It's already late, so why don't we go together?

text_block_list.text: Huh?! Ah, um, that's...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I-I'll be f-fine! Just who do you take me
for? I'm not a damsel in
distress, y'know?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
That's that, so hurry it up! Gimme the keys
already.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I'm a little curious about the way Nature is
acting, but I hand the keys
over to her
anyway.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
My thanks! And with that, a good night to
you, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: A few hours later...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: R-r-r-ring!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hello? Is this Nature's Тренер? This is Fuji
Kiseki, dorm leader of Ritto
Dormitory,
speaking.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
It's already an hour past curfew, but
Nature hasn't come back yet.
Would you
have any ideas as to where she might be?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
There's no time to panic! First, I should
check the trainer's office!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I run through the dimly-lit academy, finally
arriving in front of the
trainer's office.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Coming around from the outside is none
other than Токай Тэйо! It's
the final stretch!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Токай Тэйо leaps into the front! She breaks
out of the pack... and
across the line!
Winning by two whole lengths, Токай Тэйо
takes home
the gold!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Opening the door, I find Nature staring
intently at footage of Tokai
Teio.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yawn... O-o-ow... neck... stiff.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Still... win after win after win. Her
positioning near the end there was

flawless—practically textbook.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Once she gets into her groove, there's no
stopping her... Yikes, I'm
getting the
heebie-jeebies.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: Are you researching Teio by yourself?

text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-whooooa?!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: T-Trainer! N-no way—why're you here?!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: I got a call from your dorm leader.

text_block_list.text:
From Fuji?! Why did she... Ahhh! The
curfew!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Augh, I totally lost track of the time. Oh
man, that's so dumb!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Looks like she got sucked into researching
Токай Тейо and didn't
realize it was this
late already.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Um... Sorry about lying to you earlier.
Here's the key. I'll go apologize
to Fuji
too.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: You want to beat Токай Тэйо, don't you?

text_block_list.text: Huh?! Nah, it's not—
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: ...It's not that simple.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I told you plenty of times, haven't I?
That... I'm not built like the
others.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
With a hint of frustration in her tone,
Nature slowly walks towards the
window
before gazing up at the night sky.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm not like those dazzling stars—I can't
shine like they do. I'm not the
main
character of this story.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Of course, there was a time when I thought
I was, y'know? I wouldn't
have come to
Tracen otherwise.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: But now... I know the the cold, hard truth.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
No matter how fast I run, there's always
someone out there who's
faster.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Everyone cheered me on—even threw me a
send-off fit for a queen.
But when I'm next
to real stars, there's no way I can compare
to their
radiance.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
To put it simply, I'm just one of those
extras you see all the time in
movies.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I'm not cut out for the leading role... I
know that better than anyone.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
An extra like me has no business aiming for
first... It's pathetic, isn't
it?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: You're not pathetic in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list:
When you give it your all, you shine brighter
than any other star.

text_block_list.text:
...I-I can't shine like the others. So stop it,
Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Please... just stop.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
She speaks firmly, but when I look at her,
her eyes seem to waver.
Perhaps my words
reached her?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After some time, we go back to Nature's
dorm and apologize to Fuji
Kiseki
together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: The next day, after training...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Тренер? After this, you mind if I
check out some Teio footage
again?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Oh, um, don't get me wrong, okay? It's not
because I'm super pumped
about facing
Teio. Not even close.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: It's just... well...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Even if first place is out of reach... even if
victory is impossible... I-I
still want to say
that I tried my best...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Mhm. Well, let's get going!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
And so, the two us begin dedicating every
waking moment to training
for the
upcoming Tracen Meet.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
